sources.name: ledger_lens_pg
sources.description: Synthetic freelancer dataset: 9 clients, 54 invoices, 132 time logs, 168 bank transactions, 10 subscriptions.

sources.name: fx_rest
sources.description: Public EUR/MAD reference rate (currency-api via jsDelivr), display-only conversion.

client_profitability.description: One row per client per month. Shows logged vs invoiced hours, unbilled hours and percentage, the client's rate vs market rate, effective realized rate, and revenue invoiced/received.

columns.month: First day of the work month (2026-04-01 to 2026-09-01).
columns.hours_billed: Hours on time logs linked to an invoice.
columns.unbilled_hours: hours_logged minus hours_billed; the unbilled-hours leak signal.
columns.unbilled_pct: unbilled_hours as a percentage of hours_logged (0-100).
columns.market_rate: Typical market rate for the service in EUR/hour.
columns.effective_rate: revenue_invoiced divided by hours_logged (EUR/hour actually realized).
columns.revenue_invoiced: Invoice amount attributed to the month the work was logged.
columns.revenue_received: Client payments attributed to the month the invoice was paid.

cash_position.description: One row per day. Daily money in, money out, net movement, and the end-of-day running balance. Includes the 2026-03-31 opening balance in the running total.

subscription_usage.description: One row per subscription. Compares the current list price with the first and last actual charges, measures price change, days since login, duplicate charges in any month, and total charged.

columns.vendor: Vendor name as it appears on the bank statement.
columns.first_charge_amount: First actual charge in the window in EUR.
columns.last_charge_amount: Last actual charge in the window in EUR.
columns.price_change_pct: Percentage change from first to last charge; > 15 is the quiet-price-rise signal.
columns.days_since_login: Days between last_login_date and the fixed demo date 2026-10-01; > 60 is the unused-subscription signal.
columns.max_charges_in_a_month: Largest number of charges in one month; > 1 is the duplicate-charge signal.
columns.total_charged: Total charged over the six-month window in EUR.

ar_aging.description: One row per invoice. Measures how many days late each invoice is paid (or is overdue at the demo date), buckets it, and carries the invoice status.

columns.due_date: Payment due date (issue date plus payment terms).
columns.paid_date: Date the invoice was paid, or null if unpaid.
columns.days_late: Days between due_date and paid_date (or 2026-10-01 if unpaid); 0 when on time.

fx_rates.description: Display-only EUR/MAD reference rate for every date from 2026-03-31 to 2026-10-01. Never used by an agent's money math.

columns.date: Calendar day covered by the rate.
